newsitem.title: USA: May Brent ends lower in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: May Brent ends lower in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent ended lower in late U.S. paper trading on Friday, traders said.
A top Wall Street firm sold the bulk of a series of May Brent partials of 100 lots apiece to a variety of buyers at prices ranging from $19.65 to $19.79 a barrel.
May Brent started the window at the high end and was sold off to the $19.60s range, a broker said.
May Brent settled at $19.74 on the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) in London.
Two April/May Brent spreads changed hands at plus 28 cents a barrel, down four cents from the lowest trade done before the IPE close.
April/May was done as high as plus 50 cents a barrel earlier in the day.
